subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@zenhealth.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo follow-up — SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM details

Hi Lisa & Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: You asked about our current audit status and whether we can share a report or summary of controls. I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and added a Drive link below with our most recent report under NDA.
- SSO / provisioning: We support SAML 2.0 for IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO and SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning. Attached is a short SSO config guide and an IAM diagram for your infra team.
- RBAC & admin controls: Roles include Org Admin, Billing Admin, App Admin, and Viewer. We can provide screenshots and an export of role-permission mappings on request.

Next steps:
1) Lisa/ Rajiv — let me know which items you want as formal evidence (SOC 2 full report under NDA vs summary; SCIM API spec; SSO metadata).
2) If you want SCIM test credentials, reply with a point of contact and a preferred time to run a provisioning test.
3) Aditya — can you pull together the SCIM API spec excerpt and the role-permission CSV for ZenHealth? If possible, by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-ssoconfig-guide.pdf, iam-diagram.png

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://www.redwoodai.com
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@zenhealth.com>

Date: 2027-04-25T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM details

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and docs. Quick notes from our security and identity teams: 

- SOC 2: We need the SOC 2 Type II report (latest) under NDA for our procurement review. Is that available? If not, the summary will help while we process the NDA.
- SSO/SCIM: Our IdP is Okta. We typically do SP-initiated SAML with Just-in-Time (JIT) provisioning via SCIM. Can you confirm support for Okta-specific attributes (email, firstName, lastName, title, groups) and whether group-to-role mapping is supported via SCIM?
- RBAC: We need a concrete list of admin controls and the process for granting Org Admin. Who approves, and is there an audit log for admin role changes?

We can run a short technical call with your infra/security engineer next week to validate SCIM and SAML flows. Thursday morning PT works for us.

Thanks — Lisa
Lisa Chen
Director of IT Security | ZenHealth
lisa.chen@zenhealth.com | +1 (212) 555-6789

- Evidence of admin role change audit logs and the approval workflow for Org Admin assignments

Can you:

Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM details

Hi all — quick update from the infra/security side: 

- SOC 2: We can provide the Type II report under NDA. Marissa — please send the standard mutual NDA link and I will share the report once countersigned.
- SCIM / Okta: We support the common Okta attributes you listed (email, firstName, lastName, title, groups). Group-to-role mapping is supported via SCIM with a mapping table; I attached an excerpt (SCIM-okta-mapping.csv) to the internal copy and will provide a sanitized example for ZenHealth.
- RBAC & admin audit logs: We maintain an immutable audit trail for role changes (timestamp, actor email, previous_role, new_role). I've attached a redacted sample audit export and a short description of the Org Admin approval flow: requests originate from the org owner, are approved by Security or Legal for enterprise accounts, and changes are logged with a ticket reference if applicable.

Next technical step: propose a 30-minute call next Thursday 10:00 AM PT to walk through SAML metadata and perform a SCIM provisioning smoke test. Marissa — can you confirm with Lisa?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Staff Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodai.com
